items.item: MLB 2022–2026 CBA Expires Dec 1, 2026 (11:59 PM ET) — Potential 2027 Lockout
items.details: While MLB officially published the complete 2027 Spring Training & Regular Season schedule on July 16, 2026 (all 2,430 games verified via statsapi.mlb.com), the current Collective Bargaining Agreement expires Dec 1, 2026. If a lockout begins Dec 2, 2026 and extends past mid-February 2027, 2027 Spring Training (scheduled to open Feb 19, 2027) or Opening Day (Mar 24–25, 2027) could be delayed — which would artificially EXPAND the Feb–Mar 2027 zero-sports vacation window.

items.item: 594 of 2,430 Official 2027 MLB Regular Season Games & 105 Spring Training Games Have startTimeTBD = true
items.details: In the official MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com) as of Nov 25, 2026, six clubs (notably SF Giants home games, LA Dodgers home games, Chicago Cubs, Chicago White Sox, Boston Red Sox, Cleveland Guardians, Toronto Blue Jays, and select Detroit Tigers games) have confirmed matchups and dates for 2027 but have not finalized exact first-pitch times (API stores placeholder 07:33Z/08:33Z/10:33Z with startTimeTBD:true). items.item: NFL AFC–NFC Pro Bowl Game Discontinued Beginning 2026–27 Season
items.details: On August 27, 2026, the NFL officially announced that the AFC–NFC Pro Bowl game will cease being contested beginning with the 2026 season, replaced by an in-person player celebration and flag football showcase events during Super Bowl LXI week in Los Angeles (early Feb 2027). Because no official traditional Pro Bowl radio game is scheduled, Feb 1–13, 2027 currently has NO verified NFL games — however, check late-Jan 2027 announcements in case Westwood One broadcasts any LA Pro Bowl week flag showcase.
items.action_needed: Verify in late Jan 2027 whether Westwood One or KNBR airs any Super Bowl week flag showcase on terrestrial AM/FM.

items.item: Super Bowl LXIII (Las Vegas) Date Could Shift From Feb 11 to Feb 18, 2029 Under Potential 18-Game Season
items.details: Allegiant Stadium (Las Vegas) was officially confirmed as host of Super Bowl LXIII on March 30, 2026. Under the current 17-game NFL format, Super Bowl LXIII projects to Sun Feb 11, 2029. If the NFL and NFLPA adopt an 18-game regular season before 2028, Super Bowl LXIII would likely shift one week later to Sun Feb 18, 2029 (Presidents' Day Weekend), compressing the Feb 2029 gap before MLB Spring Training.

items.item: Warriors (NBA), Valkyries (WNBA), & Earthquakes (MLS) Air on Local AM/FM (95.7 FM & 810 AM)
items.details: Research confirmed Golden State Warriors (Oct–Apr + Playoffs) and Golden State Valkyries (May–Sep + Playoffs) air locally on KGMZ 95.7 FM, and San Jose Earthquakes (Feb–Oct) air on KSFO 810 AM — both strong signals in Outer Sunset 94122. Because their schedules span Oct–Sep, including NBA/WNBA/MLS would eliminate even the Feb–Mar regular-season vacation window! The dashboard flags them as High-Priority Local Radio Awareness on the Radio Guide and Executive Summary.
items.action_needed: If you also want to avoid Warriors/Valkyries/Earthquakes games, check KGMZ 95.7 FM / KSFO 810 AM schedules before booking Feb–Mar travel.
